title: Psionics as part of the Cold War retrieval and reverse-engineering program

tellings.quote: go back to GR and Carl subroa cold war to retrieve or reverse engineer this stuff. Well, the psionics part is a part of that retrieval program and reverse engineering program.

plain: Psionics, the study and use of mind powers, was part of a Cold War program to recover crashed objects and copy their technology, according to the researcher Matthew Pines. He tells Michels this without naming a source, which, if true, would tie research on the mind directly to the hunt for non-human craft.
